title: unique0 Case Allows Zero-Match — Silent Miss
description: unique0 case permits the condition (1'b1) to match zero branches without a runtime error; if both state bits are low the case silently falls through, leaving next_state undriven.
bug_signature: VCS-WARNING: unique0 case matched zero branches for state=10'h000; next_state retains stale value
expected_root_cause: The unique0 qualifier allows the case expression to match zero branches without error; when no state bit is set next_state is silently left at its previous value, causing the FSM to stall in an unintended state.
rtl:
always_comb begin
  unique0 case (1'b1)
    state[0]: next_state = S1;  // Silently skipped if state[0]=0 and state[9]=0
    state[9]: next_state = S0;
  endcase
end
failure_log: VCS-WARNING: unique0 case matched zero branches for state=10'h000; next_state retains stale value
success_log: unique case: all one-hot state values match exactly one branch. Zero-match eliminated.
fix_replacement:
always_comb begin
  next_state = S0;  // Default before case prevents silent miss
  unique case (1'b1)
    state[0]: next_state = S1;
    state[9]: next_state = S0;
  endcase
end
